words.definition: The amount of money you pay for something.
words.example: What's the price of this jacket?

words.definition: To give money for something you buy or a service.
words.example: Can I pay by card?

words.definition: What you use to buy things.
words.example: I don't have much money this month.

words.definition: Money in bills and coins.
words.example: Do you take cash?

words.definition: A place where things are sold.
words.example: The store closes at nine.

words.definition: To give something to someone in exchange for money.
words.example: They sell fresh bread here.

words.definition: How big or small something is.
words.example: Do you have this in a larger size?

words.definition: A container made of paper, plastic or cloth for carrying things.
words.example: Would you like a bag for that?

words.definition: The money you get back when you pay more than the price.
words.example: Here's your change. Have a nice day!

words.definition: A lower price than usual.
words.example: Is there a discount for students?

words.definition: The second largest continent.
words.example: We went on safari in Africa.

words.definition: The largest continent.
words.example: He travels around Asia.

words.definition: A continent west of Asia.
words.example: We visited Europe last summer.

words.definition: The continents of North and South America, or the United States.
words.example: She moved to America.

words.definition: A country and continent in the southern hemisphere.
words.example: Kangaroos live in Australia.

words.definition: The icy continent around the South Pole.
words.example: Antarctica is very cold.

words.definition: A country in North America.
words.example: He lives in Canada.

words.definition: A country south of the US.
words.example: We vacationed in Mexico.

words.definition: The largest country in South America.
words.example: She's from Brazil.

words.definition: A country in South Asia.
words.example: India has a huge population.

words.definition: The work you do to earn money.
words.example: She just got a new job downtown.

words.definition: To do a job, or to do something that needs effort.
words.example: Where do you work?

words.definition: A person who treats sick people.
words.example: I have an appointment with the doctor.

words.definition: A person who looks after sick people in a hospital or clinic.
words.example: The nurse took my temperature.

words.definition: A person who grows crops or raises animals.
words.example: The farmer sells his eggs at the market.

words.definition: A professional cook, especially in a restaurant.
words.example: The chef came out to say hello.

words.definition: The person who is in charge of you at work.
words.example: My boss is out of the office today.

words.definition: A person who is in charge of a team, shop or department.
words.example: My manager approved my vacation.

words.definition: A person who designs or builds machines, roads or systems.
words.example: My sister is an engineer at a car company.

words.definition: A person who brings food to your table in a restaurant.
words.example: Our waiter was very friendly.

words.definition: A device you use to call and message people.
words.example: My phone is almost dead.

words.definition: A machine you use to work, play and go online.
words.example: My computer is very slow today.

words.definition: The worldwide network that connects computers and phones.
words.example: The internet is down again.

words.definition: Words you send to someone in writing or by voice.
words.example: I'll send you a message later.

words.definition: The flat part of a phone or computer that shows pictures and words.
words.example: Don't stare at the screen all day.

words.definition: A device inside a phone or toy that stores power.
words.example: My battery is at ten percent.

words.definition: To put power into a battery.
words.example: Can I charge my phone here?

words.definition: A message sent over the internet.
words.example: I got an email from my landlord.

words.definition: A secret word you type to get into an account.
words.example: I forgot my password again.

words.definition: A device for taking photos or videos.
words.example: The camera on this phone is amazing.

words.definition: Every time, without exception.
words.example: She always arrives early.

words.definition: In most cases; normally.
words.example: I usually walk to work.

words.definition: Many times; frequently.
words.example: How often do you go to the gym?

words.definition: On some occasions, but not always.
words.example: Sometimes we eat out on Fridays.

words.definition: At no time; not ever.
words.example: I've never been to Japan.

words.definition: One more time.
words.example: Can you say that again?

words.definition: Before now, or sooner than expected.
words.example: I already ate, thanks.

words.definition: Up to now, and not finished.
words.example: Are you still at work?

words.definition: In a short time from now.
words.example: See you soon!

words.definition: Very quickly and without warning.
words.example: Suddenly, the lights went out.

words.definition: An adult male person.
words.example: Who's that man at the door?

words.definition: An adult female person.
words.example: That woman over there is my aunt.

words.definition: A male child.
words.example: The boy next door plays the drums.

words.definition: A female child.
words.example: Their little girl just started school.

words.definition: More than one person.
words.example: A lot of people were at the concert.

words.definition: A person who lives next to you or near you.
words.example: My neighbor waters my plants when I travel.

words.definition: A person you do not know.
words.example: I didn't know anyone at the party. Everyone was a stranger.

words.definition: A person you invite to your home or event.
words.example: We have guests coming for dinner.

words.definition: A young person between thirteen and nineteen years old.
words.example: My teenager sleeps until noon on weekends.

words.definition: A person who is fully grown.
words.example: Tickets are ten dollars for an adult.

words.definition: How well your body and mind are.
words.example: Your health is more important than work.

words.definition: A drug you take to get better.
words.example: Take this medicine twice a day.

words.definition: The uncomfortable feeling you get when something hurts.
words.example: I have a sharp pain in my knee.

words.definition: A pain in your head.
words.example: I've had a headache since this morning.

words.definition: A body temperature that is higher than normal.
words.example: He has a fever, so he stayed home.

words.definition: A sudden noise you make when air shoots out of your throat.
words.example: That cough sounds terrible.

words.definition: To feel pain, or to cause pain.
words.example: Does it hurt when I press here?

words.definition: To relax and stop working so your body can recover.
words.example: You should rest and drink lots of water.

words.definition: A shop where you buy medicine.
words.example: The pharmacy is open until midnight.

words.definition: A time you arrange to see someone, like a doctor.
words.example: I need to make an appointment with the dentist.

words.definition: Having more height than usual.
words.example: He's very tall.

words.definition: Not tall, or not long.
words.example: She has short hair.

words.definition: Having lived for only a short time.
words.example: My brother is too young to drive.

words.definition: Having great physical power.
words.example: He's strong enough to lift that box.

words.definition: Friendly, generous and caring toward others.
words.example: It was kind of you to help.

words.definition: Behaving in a pleasant way toward other people.
words.example: Everyone here is so friendly.

words.definition: Nervous and quiet around other people.
words.example: He's shy around new people.

words.definition: Having good manners and respect for others.
words.example: It's polite to say thank you.

words.definition: Able to learn and understand things quickly.
words.example: She's smart and works hard.

words.definition: Not wanting to work or make an effort.
words.example: I felt lazy, so I stayed in bed all day.

words.definition: A piece of furniture you sleep on.
words.example: I'm going to bed. Good night!

words.definition: A long soft seat for two or more people.
words.example: He fell asleep on the sofa.

words.definition: A light that you can move, with a bulb inside.
words.example: Turn on the lamp. It's too dark.

words.definition: A piece of glass where you can see yourself.
words.example: She checked her hair in the mirror.

words.definition: A flat board on a wall where you put things.
words.example: The books are on the top shelf.

words.definition: A thick cover for a floor.
words.example: We need to clean the carpet.

words.definition: A piece of cloth that hangs over a window.
words.example: Close the curtains. The sun is in my eyes.

words.definition: A device that shows programs, or the programs themselves.
words.example: What's on television tonight?

words.definition: A machine that shows the time.
words.example: That clock is ten minutes slow.

words.definition: A piece of land near a house where people grow flowers or vegetables.
words.example: We grow tomatoes in our garden.

words.definition: The season after winter, when plants start to grow.
words.example: The flowers come out in spring.

words.definition: The warmest season of the year.
words.example: We go to the lake every summer.

words.definition: The season between summer and winter, when leaves fall.
words.example: The leaves turn red in autumn.

words.definition: The coldest season of the year.
words.example: It gets dark early in winter.

words.definition: One of the twelve parts of a year, like May or June.
words.example: I'll finish this by the end of the month.

words.definition: A period of twelve months.
words.example: I started my job last year.

words.definition: One of the four parts of the year.
words.example: Which season do you like best?

words.definition: A chart that shows the days, weeks and months of the year.
words.example: Put the party on the calendar.

words.definition: The day each year when you celebrate being born.
words.example: Happy birthday! How old are you today?

words.definition: A day when most people do not work or go to school.
words.example: We have a holiday on Monday.
